start: A gym asked for a demo on the website an hour ago

steps.action: Open 'Leads' (side menu, or More then Leads on a phone)
user_sees: 'Gyms that asked for a free demo on the website. Kept 12 months unless they become a customer.'
A card with the gym name, city and phone number, and the time it came in
must_not: Leads of another kind mixed in with no word

user_sees: The phone dialer opens with +91 and the number

steps.action: Pick 'Called' in the status box, type a note, tap 'Save'
must_not: The status back to New after a reload
The note cut without a word

start: Leads page, a lead that has said yes after the demo

steps.action: Tap 'Make a gym for this lead'
user_sees: The make-a-gym form opens under the lead card, filled with the gym name and phone
must_not: The form filled with another lead's details

steps.action: Finish the form and make the gym
user_sees: The new gym and its sign-in details
must_not: Two gyms made by a second tap

start: A member used 'Recommend MettleUp to your gym' on mettleup.fit; Needs you shows the new lead

steps.action: On 'Needs you' tap '1 new lead to call'
must_not: The count of shared-link leads different from the cards marked as such

user_sees: ' · from a member’s shared link' after the time
' · Hindi' when the form was filled in Hindi
must_not: The member's own name or number shown as the gym's

start: Leads page with a lead sent without a gym name

user_sees: 'Gym name: not entered' in place of the name
must_not: The Make a gym form with the word 'null'

steps.action: Another tab deletes that lead; tap 'Save' on it here
user_sees: 'That gym or request is not there any more. The page was refreshed.'
must_not: 'Saved.' for a lead that is gone

steps.action: Open Leads while Cloudflare's small database is not connected
user_sees: 'Feedback, leads and AI use are not connected yet.'
must_not: An empty list that says 'No leads yet.'

steps.action: Move it New, Called, Demo, Won, tapping 'Save' each time; reload the page
user_sees: 'Saved.' each time; after reload the box shows 'Won'
must_not: The Needs you count still counting it as new after a minute

steps.action: Open Leads when no lead was ever sent

start: Leads page holding phone numbers of people who filled the demo form

user_sees: Later, the Log line 'Looked at leads'
must_not: Lead numbers used for anything but a call back about MettleUp
A lead older than 12 months still listed when it never became a customer
